# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VOLUME_DRY_UP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Gaps that occur on low relative volume lack conviction and tend to fade back toward the prior day's VWAP or opening range. The edge exists because low-volume gaps are often driven by imbalanced liquidity or overnight news that fails to sustain momentum, leading to mean reversion as institutional participants step in to provide liquidity or fade the move.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger: If today's opening gap (today's open minus prior day's close) exceeds 0.2% of SPY price AND volume on the opening 5-minute bar is <0.7× the average volume of the prior 20 five-minute bars, then enter short at the midpoint of the gap ((open + prior close)/2) using a limit order. If price moves against the position (i.e., gaps further in the direction of the initial gap), wait for a retrace to VWAP and enter short on a bearish rejection candle (close<open, upper wick ≥0.5×body) at VWAP. Exit: Stop above the high of the gap bar; target 1R; if price reaches 0.5R, tighten stop to break-even; runner uses a 20% trailing stop from the lowest low. Regime filter: Only active when VIX >18 and during the first 30 minutes after open; avoid if gap volume exceeds average (indicates strong conviction).
